title: Welcome to WoodworkingShop!
subtitle: Design, optimize, and build your furniture in 3 easy steps.
wizardStep1Desc: Choose furniture type, dimensions, materials, doors, drawers, and shelves to match your space.
wizardStep2Desc: The cut optimizer nests every part onto your sheet materials — minimising waste and producing a printable layout.
wizardStep3Desc: Download a PDF plan, DXF for CNC, G-code for machine tools, or a CSV bill of materials — then follow the assembly guide.
